title: What will you accomplish today?
inputPlaceholder: Describe a task and let AI handle the rest

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.empty: Star completed or interrupted tasks to see them here.

saasMetricsDashboard.title: SaaS Metrics Dashboard
saasMetricsDashboard.description: Build a dashboard with MRR, ARR, churn, LTV, and CAC.
saasMetricsDashboard.prompt: Build a SaaS metrics dashboard in Google Sheets with MRR, ARR, churn rate, LTV, and CAC from my subscription data.

budgetVsActuals.title: Budget vs Actuals
budgetVsActuals.description: Compare actuals against budget with variance analysis.
budgetVsActuals.prompt: Compare this month's actuals against budget in Google Sheets, calculate variances, and create a summary slide in Google Slides.

expenseReportProcess.title: Expense Report Processing
expenseReportProcess.description: Categorize expenses and generate a formatted report.
expenseReportProcess.prompt: Process these expense receipts, categorize them by GL code, flag any policy violations, and generate a formatted expense report in Google Sheets.

boardDeckPrep.title: Board Deck Prep
boardDeckPrep.description: Pull financial metrics into a board meeting deck.
boardDeckPrep.prompt: Pull key financial metrics from my Google Sheets and create a board meeting deck in Google Slides with MRR trends, burn rate, and runway.

revenueRecognition.title: Revenue Recognition
revenueRecognition.description: Review subscription data against ASC 606 criteria.
revenueRecognition.prompt: Review the subscription revenue data in this Google Sheet against ASC 606 recognition criteria and flag any items needing adjustment.

vendorContractReview.title: Vendor Contract Review
vendorContractReview.description: Extract key terms and flag risks from a vendor contract.
vendorContractReview.prompt: Review this vendor contract and extract key terms, renewal dates, pricing, termination clauses, and risk flags into a Google Doc summary.

earningsCallPrep.title: Earnings Call Prep
earningsCallPrep.description: Research peer metrics and draft talking points.
earningsCallPrep.prompt: Research peer company metrics on Yahoo Finance and draft earnings call talking points in Google Docs with key financial comparisons.

secFilingResearch.title: SEC Filing Research
secFilingResearch.description: Search competitor filings and summarize key data.
secFilingResearch.prompt: Search SEC EDGAR for competitor 10-K filings, extract key financial data, and summarize findings in a Google Doc.

financialModelUpdate.title: Financial Model Update
financialModelUpdate.description: Update a forecasting model with latest actuals.
financialModelUpdate.prompt: Update the forecasting model in this Google Sheet with the latest monthly actuals and recalculate projections for the next 12 months.
